text: Hino ka leydi tummbe ɓadondirɗe, hino ton kadi gese 'inabu, e remuruuji, e tamarooje dukkinɗe e salndu wooturu, goɗɗe dukkiniri calɗi calɗi. Ɗen gese e remuruuji no yarniree ndiyam gootam. Meɗen ɓurna yoga majji dow yoga ka dakamme ekw immorde e nafooreeji, e hoore ko ɗi ɓadondiri kon fow ɗi yariraa ndiyam gootam. Wonii e ko jantaa koo, dalilaaji e ɓannganndaduyeeji, wonannde yimɓe haqqilooɓe; tawde ko kamɓe woni taskotooɓe ɗum.
